tools.name: sysmon_pulse
tools.description: Whole-device health pulse covering CPU busy/PSI, physical RAM & Memory PSI/LMKD, Storage throughput/IO PSI/D-state wait, Thermal/Power, plus top resource-consuming processes in one call.

start_ts.description: Optional window start timestamp in ns (defaults to current view/brush).

end_ts.description: Optional window end timestamp in ns (defaults to current view/brush).

queries.pulse: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE sysmon.pulse; SELECT * FROM sysmon_pulse($start_ts, $end_ts);
queries.top_processes: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE sysmon.processes; SELECT * FROM sysmon_top_processes($start_ts, $end_ts, 10);

tools.name: sysmon_memory
tools.description: Whole-system memory breakdown: MemTotal physical RAM ledger (Anon, File Cache, Kernel/Slab, DMA-BUF/GPU, ZRAM, Free), reclaim/PSI/swap/LMKD pressure, and top memory-holding processes.

queries.ledger: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE sysmon.memory; SELECT * FROM sysmon_memtotal_ledger($start_ts, $end_ts);
queries.reclaim: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE sysmon.memory; SELECT * FROM sysmon_reclaim_summary($start_ts, $end_ts);
queries.lmkd_kills: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE sysmon.memory; SELECT * FROM sysmon_lmkd_kills($start_ts, $end_ts);
queries.top_processes: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE sysmon.memory; SELECT * FROM sysmon_top_memory_processes($start_ts, $end_ts, coalesce($limit, 12));

tools.name: sysmon_cpu
tools.description: Whole-system CPU utilization & frequency per core, thread time-in-state wait breakdown (Running, Runnable, Disk I/O Wait, Uninterruptible), and top threads.

queries.cores: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE sysmon.cpu; SELECT * FROM sysmon_cpu_cores($start_ts, $end_ts);
queries.waits: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE sysmon.cpu; SELECT * FROM sysmon_wait_breakdown($start_ts, $end_ts);
queries.top_threads: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE sysmon.cpu; SELECT * FROM sysmon_top_cpu_threads($start_ts, $end_ts, coalesce($limit, 12));

tools.name: sysmon_cpu_wait_explainer
tools.description: Level-2 wait explainer: shows which threads waited most for a specific wait category ('runnable', 'io_wait', or 'uninterruptible'), their kernel blocked_function, and which threads woke them.
tools.sql: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE sysmon.cpu; SELECT * FROM sysmon_wait_explainer($start_ts, $end_ts, $category, coalesce($limit, 15));

tools.name: sysmon_storage
tools.description: System-wide storage summary (Read/Write MB & MB/s, IO PSI, D-state I/O wait, Dirty/Writeback, File vs Swap paging) and top I/O processes.

queries.summary: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE sysmon.storage; SELECT * FROM sysmon_storage_summary($start_ts, $end_ts);
queries.top_processes: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE sysmon.storage; SELECT * FROM sysmon_storage_processes($start_ts, $end_ts, coalesce($limit, 12));

tools.name: sysmon_thermal_power
tools.description: Thermal zone temperatures (min/avg/peak °C) and ODPM power rail draw (mW / mJ), when exposed by the device.

queries.thermal_zones: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE sysmon.thermal; SELECT * FROM sysmon_thermal_zones($start_ts, $end_ts, coalesce($limit, 12));
queries.power_rails: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE sysmon.thermal; SELECT * FROM sysmon_power_rails($start_ts, $end_ts, coalesce($limit, 12));
